results.title: Is LinkedIn Automation Safe in 2026? ToS & Scraping Rules
results.snippet: The takeaway for 2026: as the Electronic Frontier Foundation and legal analysts at Farella Braun + Martel note, scraping public data may survive a CFAA challenge, but it can still expose you to breach-of-contract liability whenever a site's terms prohibit it — and LinkedIn's User Agreement explicitly does. For an individual professional, the practical risk is not a lawsuit; it is the account restriction LinkedIn can apply the moment its systems detect the scraper.
